data.text:
CRUSH THE BALIGOD-DEFENSOR FILTH: DRAG THE PUPPETMASTERS TO THE DUNGEON

Like rats scurrying in sync toward a pre-planned feast of filth, the Sara Duterte camp, with the ever-opportunistic Chavit Singson leading the pack, is now screeching for a Senate investigation into the Baligod-Defensor joint affidavit.

Make no mistake: this wasn't an accident. This was a calculated, high-octane conspiracy. That pathetic Club Filipino press conference was merely the first vomit-inducing act in a theatrical plot designed to poison the public mind.
Yet, for all their posturing, it was nothing but a pathetic storm in a cracked teapot. The affidavit is a Swiss-cheese document, riddled with holes so glaring they insult the intelligence of the Filipino people. To suggest that Leila de Lima or Tito Sotto were hauling suitcases of cash while one was out of office and the other was literally behind bars is not just an error; it is a hallucinatory lie.

By peddling the delusional fantasy that the ICC was bribed, these charlatans haven't just lied to us, they have dragged the nation's dignity through the mud, making the Philippines a global laughingstock.

The stench of this "shitshow" radiates directly from two men: Atty. Levi Baligod and Mike Defensor. Those eighteen ex-Marines? Nothing but brainless props, silenced and paraded like livestock. This wasn't a quest for justice; it was a Baligod-Defensor ego-trip fueled by malice.

NO MERCY, NO ESCAPE
If these ex-Marines cannot defend their scripted fiction or if they trip over their own contradictions, then the hammer must fall, not just on the pawns, but on the kings.
 ➡️ Contempt: Baligod and Defensor must be thrown into a cell immediately for daring to mock our institutions.
 ➡️ Perjury: They must be prosecuted with the full, unbridled weight of the law for every syllable of their fabricated testimony.
 ➡️ Total Accountability: You do not get to pollute the public record with toxic waste and then walk away unscathed.

They should be forced to choke on their own lies while rotting in a prison cell. It is time to stop treating these professional liars with kid gloves and start treating them like the national cancers they are.

@indaysara @MikeDefensor @senatePH @HouseofRepsPH @manayleila @sotto_tito
